content:
Mental prayer is the furnace in which the soul is purified and inflamed with the love of God. Without this exercise the soul remains cold, imperfect, and easily falls into sin. St. Teresa used to say that he who neglects mental prayer does not need the devil to cast him into hell; he casts himself there.

Give at least half an hour every day to this holy exercise. Begin by placing yourself in the presence of God. Consider that He is looking at you, that He loves you, and that He desires to speak to your heart. Then read a short passage of Scripture or a spiritual book, and pause to reflect upon it. Speak to God from your heart about what you have read. Ask for the graces you need. End by making a practical resolution for the day.

Those who are faithful to daily mental prayer make rapid progress in virtue. Those who omit it remain for years in the same faults. If you find dryness, do not abandon the exercise; remain in the presence of God with humility and continue to ask for His light. Perseverance in prayer is the surest mark of predestination.
